headline: Oil prices fall after stock build-up and US-Iran clashes
summary: Oil prices declined after US crude and fuel inventories rose, though losses were limited by ongoing US-Iran clashes and attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz.
why: Crude oil is a global benchmark commodity, and supply disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz affect a large share of seaborne oil trade.
why_moved: Higher US crude and fuel stocks added supply pressure, while clashes between the US and Iran and attacks on ships in Hormuz limited the decline.
original_headline: Precios del petróleo caen tras aumento de existencias y enfrentamientos EU-Irán
